Sample.evidence_source: Participants were 1,000 German adults (50% female) aged 18 to 85 years (M = 49.8, SD = 16.7) recruited from a large online panel. At Time 1, the mean SWLS score was 5.12 (SD = 1.23), and at Time 2, it was 5.08 (SD = 1.25).
